findings.title: The canonical hash test never changes the version value
findings.claim: The new test says it verifies that canonical hashing ignores the version, but it only changes crew health. It would still pass if the version-zeroing line were removed.
findings.why: The version-only proof depends on excluding SIM_VERSION from the per-tick hash. This test cannot catch a regression in that behavior.
findings.fix: Test two canonical inputs that differ only at flatten index 0 and assert equal hashes; retain the health-field assertion to prove other changes are detected.

The capture script has no write path and exits 1. scripts/capture-net1a-baseline.ts:L1-L4.
